lines: Bina's Spotter's Helm: the 2% more per shot in a row is now counted per Ballista and starts again for every new Ballista, as a test in the game showed. The sim averages it over a Ballista's life, so totem duration and totem speed raise it (attack speed does not). It was a flat 50% more; most builds now get between about 20% and 45%.
With The Unfallen Ancestor your Ballistas never expire, so the helm's ramp counts the full 50%.

Rime Sprites, Cinder Mites and Brass Sentinels now count "+1 to maximum number of minions" lines (like the Core Touched minion amulets): one more companion and 3% more damage of its element each, as the game shows.
Translations: the Market, Vows and Riven Atlas tabs, the newer Item Simulator options, the Damage tab stats panel and the FAQ card on ailment damage are now in all ten page languages.
Patch 90: critical strikes no longer make Bleeding, Ignite or Poison bigger (the game's patch notes). Hits still crit; the ailment numbers drop for crit builds.
Patch 90: a Guardian's freeze bar is now 20% of its life every time (it was 12%, each next bar 50% bigger), so freeze-based helpers and Frostbreak count more Brittle windows.
Patch 90: increased Vow effect from gear and the tree now adds to the Vow's own bonus instead of multiplying it, as the game does now.

Passive tree: Oath of the Pyre, Oath of the Long Night, One Breath, Hammer of Judgement and 9 other nodes no longer show their bursts and sky swords under "Not in the DPS number": the sim counts them (the last update meant to do this but missed).
Passive tree: nodes you marked keep are green now whether you have them or not (taken ones were gold), so a node you want no longer looks forgotten after Apply.

Oath of the Long Night: its frost burst (every third Cold hit, 50% of the hit) is now in the DPS, also when the Cold comes from conversion (Chain Lightning with Ice), as the game's character sheet counts it.
Passive tree: bursts and pillars the sim counts (Oath of the Pyre, Hammer of Judgement, One Breath and others) are no longer listed under "Not in the DPS number".

Conversion: damage converted from one element to another (Lightning to Cold with Ice or Stormfrost, Lightning to Fire with Flame, and so on) now gains the new element's "more" lines too, as the developer's rule file says. Example: Oath of the Long Night on Chain Lightning with Ice is worth about +20% instead of +8.5%.

Gear Set Sim and Sim by Slot: every gear level now tries weapons and armour at 30% quality on Truesworn bases (Base Grade 100); Ashen bases at their 10% cap. Uniques no longer get a Base Grade, as they roll none.
Passive tree: nodes marked must take now show a green ring and flag, apart from the gold keep marks.
Dragonling: the first crown is free, each further crown costs 3 points, and you can hold several crowns, as the game’s tooltips show.
The Wyrmling’s Second Heart now raises your Dragonling Aspect’s lines (it did nothing in the sim before).
Patch 90 red unique lines are in the sim from their texts (not checked in the game yet): Split Aspect, Sentence of the Ninth Bell, Eighth Blade Ornament and Ninth Hammer Shard.
Gear Set Sim: idols the search picks now go where the set fits when you Equip it; a worn red idol no longer pushes another idol out ("No room in the Fossil").
Stats panel: hover boxes now list every line instead of stopping at "... and N more"; long lists show in two columns.
Dragonling: the new Void Aspect has its own dragon picture on the Dragonling button (deep violet), and the Arcane dragon is a paler lavender so the two purples tell apart.

Patch 90: the five Entropy supports (Entropic Focus, Hastened Ruin, Gathering Dark, Cascading Ruin, Pact of Ruin) are in the game now. They are back in the normal support picker, the support search, the support optimizer and the Save Creator.

Item window: against a Guardian, when your other skills fill its freeze bar, a new "View change as kill speed" box beside the prefixes and suffixes shows each line's effect on how fast the Guardian dies (your skill plus those skills) instead of your skill's own DPS. A line that only helps the other skills (more chill on Frost Nova, say) could show a tiny loss before; as kill speed it shows the gain.
Shield Throw: the bonus from your shield’s armour, evasion and energy shield now counts the shield’s Base Grade, as the game does (checked in game: it adds to your other increased damage).
Skills with both Trap and Skyfall linked (Shield Throw, Wheeling Axe ...) now get your increased Skyfall damage lines, as the game’s character sheet shows.
The five Entropy supports other than Chaos are marked as not in the game yet: they sit in their own group in the support picker and are left out of the support search.
